result.summary: The application displays a content string placeholder instead of a human-readable title for a section in the feed.

issues.description: The section header above the 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' card displays a technical identifier 'home_feed.popular_title' instead of the intended user-facing text (e.g., 'Popular in Tallinn').
issues.suggestion: Replace the hardcoded string key 'home_feed.popular_title' with the localized UI string representing the section title.
